notice: Published by the cmdk team for the testnet demo; not a real venue. These items describe our own test markets on Base Sepolia and are never part of a production allowlist.

items.title: Testnet markets operating normally
items.body: The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.body: On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Live market stress test: free liquidity drained, withdrawals may fail
items.body: From about 16:10 UTC on 6 November the team borrows the live market's free USDC down to 0.10 USDC for a stress test (utilization above 99%). While it lasts, lenders cannot withdraw and the borrow rate rises. Positions on the live market should leave it: move to another approved market, or exit if none is approved. The test ends when the team repays, within about 40 minutes.

items.title: Live market stress test, second run: free liquidity to be drained, withdrawals may fail
items.body: The stress test announced earlier today is repeated from about 16:45 UTC on 6 November: the team borrows the live market's free USDC down to 0.10 USDC (utilization above 99%). While it lasts, lenders cannot withdraw and the borrow rate rises. Positions on the live market should leave it: move to another approved market, or exit if none is approved. The test ends when the team repays, within about 40 minutes.
